steps.text: Using Originium Arts is not the hard part of the combat.
Red and black mist fill the air. The white silhouette within does not speak or move, not even the fringes of its clothes.
It does not dodge or fight back, simply existing there in silence, allowing the barriers around it to wither away.
A void, a vortex that devours everything.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You are...
The scenes in the cognitive realm continue to flicker. They return to where they began.
A wilderness of unknown name or location. One could call it—
Sargon.

steps.name: Pleading Voice
steps.text: Why... why would this happen...?

steps.name: Pleading Voice
steps.text: Catastrophe has destroyed our home, why must war take our lives as well?

steps.name: Pleading Voice
steps.text: Padishah, silent and wise...

steps.name: Pleading Voice
steps.text: Hear my prayer, and comfort...

steps.name: Pleading Voice
steps.text: My pain.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: ...Futile.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Search as you might in my consciousness, you will never create a vision that makes me choose to sleep in the void.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: You ■■... Padishah.

steps.name: Mantra?
steps.text: A Padishah. This is your past.

steps.name: Mantra?
steps.text: Your people sought comfort from you, but you would not even grant them an illusion, though it would have taken you little effort.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: It's not comfort, it's just a lie.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: A sweet dream cannot shaken the ancient, corrupt royalty.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I left that place, fled of my own accord.

steps.name: Mantra?
steps.text: Indeed, you are not shaken.

steps.name: Mantra?
steps.text: Your voice...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You cannot become the source of the voice, Yurodstvo. You cannot become... 'me'.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Because I cannot speak, and because you're simply—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'An Echo.'

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'People see in me the reflection of their perception and expectation.'

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: That's how you come to be.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: But to you, and to my own folly...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I have no expectation.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: You are strong...

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: You have not been tried or baptized, yet you wield power almost the same as mine.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: Yet you have neglected your power, this gift... you should have used it to proselytize and lead your people.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: What made you leave your palace? What made you give up on power and become weak?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I realized...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Knowledge is more lasting than authority. The truth is stronger than lies.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: And you...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You have spurred them onto a path of destruction, to die upon this frozen soil.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Why?
Soft laughter ripples through the air.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: It is revelation. It is ■■. It is proselytization. It is sacrifice.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: The land is about to undergo drastic changes. Those who are not strong will be destroyed.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: Therefore, I nurtured a spark, making it strong, making it spread.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: It will burn all that is impure, and all shall be born again within.
Mantra is certain she can kill it. In the realm of the mind, it will take little more effort than snuffing out a candle.
But what will killing it do? She is unsure. Besides, is there victory to be gained when your foe never engaged?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Stop wasting time, Yurodstvo.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Cease your influence on the people here, and let them leave with me.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Otherwise, Ursus will soon need a new Yurodstvo.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: Your past is thick and long, ■■.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: But it must be there, somewhere...

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: Your pain, the pain that you ■■ hide from...
There was no time for Mantra to react. A split second of hesitation is enough to cause a crack in the cognitive realm that she used all her strength to maintain.
She realizes her error almost instantly, but countless responses are already coming from outside the realm.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: I accept.

steps.name: Frail Miner
steps.text: I... I accept.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: I accept. I have long accepted.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: I can eat straw, moss, drink snow water with gravel mixed in, until my stomach is full, and I shall not hunger. Not anymore.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: See? Death is not more terrible than living.
At the end of her vision, Yurodstvo is white and slender, not a trembling apparition, nor a hunched old woman.
Whatever its appearance, it will continue to exist, as long as a single person believes in it.
The cause is not here. It is somewhere else.
Time starts flowing again. Mantra looks around, and her reason and emotion fight a war in her head, arguing about whether to try to fix the error, or beat a retreat.
Soon, she makes up her mind.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Elysium.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Right here!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I need you to use thermal imaging to mark the location from the outside. Connect me to every miner here.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Can you do it?

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Of course—

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: You got it!
The woman's cold voice appears in every miner's head.
The instant that the connection is made, she realizes that these people can no longer endure any more shocks from mental Arts.
She can only keep out Yurodstvo for so long. Time is of the essence.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Perhaps this will be cruel to you. But I believe it's necessary to reveal the truth.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: If this exodus began out of despair and manipulation, then you should at least decide your own ending.

steps.name: Frail Miner
steps.text: Who's... talking?

steps.name: Frail Miner
steps.text: How did I end up back here...?

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: We're not here! We ran away with Rankin—we cut out the chips and got away!

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: This isn't real.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You're half-correct. This is not the truth of the present, but of the past.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You killed the one on the ground. Yes or no?

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Yes, yes! We killed him... Rankin killed him!

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: I thought Rankin was a hero. He said he would take us to a place where the Infected won't be looked down on, but he abandoned us in the end...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: So you validated the truth of this scene.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: I was there! I saw it. We killed and defiled our own soul...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Look again.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Tell me. Who is it?

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Nadia, Vetochki's babushka. Everyone in the mines respected her, even the guards.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You respected her too. In the way that you respect your elders, or in the way that you respect a statue of a god?

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: There's little difference, if you live to her age in the mines.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: She stood among you. She joined the revolt.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: No, she didn't. She wasn't there... no one would ask an old woman to fight.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: She's here? Who is she looking at? Is she mourning the fallen? Why would she mourn a murderer?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Because it was she who killed him.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Rankin and your group never killed the last one who fell.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: What killed him was his hubris, and the one who created the illusion, making you blame yourself for his death.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'Yurodstvo.'
Vetochki stands by the door. She wants to leave, but her feet will not move. She wants to look straight ahead, but she does not have the courage.
She can only look down at the watch in her hand, watching the hands tick and tock, moving to the next number.
What time is it? Which one is the hour hand, and which one is the minute hand? What about the extra one?

a.text: Mama said not to sleep in the snow. You'll get cold and pass out, and heavy snow can kill.
Rankin said not to doze off in the mines. You'll faint if the air is stale, and air that you can't see will burn.
But this isn't the snow or the mines. Can we sleep here, rest here?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Who can...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Save us?

a.text: Babushka is gone. It's not Babushka Nadia standing there.
Not here. Rest, but not in someone else's home. Sleep, but not because you've lost the strength to live.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Don't sleep. Don't rest.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We'll...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Save ourselves.
She steadies the hastily-forged shield. The bell that she rang to warn the others to evacuate the mines hangs from it.
Vetochki swings her pickaxe and rings it again.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: ...So she's really the Yurodstvo?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I heard you worship her like the Yurodstvo.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: She's the Yurodstvo... she saved us! It all makes sense now.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: She comforted us, shared our pain... she was always with us.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Where were you back then?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Then she should save you now.
The miners look to the Yurodstvo. It stands silent like a statue.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Maybe we sinned too much.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The victimizer, the one who deceived and caused pain, wants the victim to endure and submit. It has always been so. You do not see any path other than to obey.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: It's not your fault.

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Do you mean that we can still be saved?

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Oh, shut it, Vasya. Does it even matter now?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Yes, you can be saved.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: If you leave here and continue your journey.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Choose to live, when living may be worse than dying.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: Hah. Get lost.

steps.name: Dazed Miner
steps.text: I thought you were going to say something new. If that's all, then I would rather die with my corpse intact, and I'm sure everyone else—

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: Bells? Who's ringing the bells?

steps.name: Pious Miner
steps.text: It's Vetochki...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Sounds like someone has made a choice.
Vetochki silently rings the bell, even though it does not sound the way it used to.
She rings it again and again, until someone stands up.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Is our shift over?

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Our shift's over.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I want to leave here.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: I want to go home...
More and more people stand up from the ground, step away from the walls, and their figures begin to drown out the white at the end of the house.
The Yurodstvo's figure trembles, passing through Mantra and the people standing up in the house.
It comes before Vetochki.

steps.name: Yurodstvo
steps.text: Child.
Vetochki looks down and does not answer the call.
She continues to ring the bell, until everyone is roused, and a dazed smile appears on their faces.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Spasibo, Vetochki.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Go back, Vetochki. Don't stay here too long.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Vetochki—

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: No, I...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I'm not going back.

steps.name: Miner
steps.text: Vetochki?
Vetochki gazes straight ahead—her companions stop smiling, and the figure of Yurodstvo is now nearly transparent.
She said, no.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We're not going back.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: We'll leave, and we'll live.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Until living, isn't the only thing, we care about, anymore.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They look so much better now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Are you alright, Mantra?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: This is Mantra.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: The communication has concluded. The miners have been freed from the Yurodstvo's control.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You defeated the Yurodstvo?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I wouldn't say that. It was the result of their own effort. The Yurodstvo has disappeared, and I was unable to track it.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: We have more important matters to attend to now.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: The Armies...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: They're here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Report, Elysium.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: No hostiles within five klicks in the direction we're traveling. We can stay the course.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: The road ahead should be easier once we're out of this stretch of tundra.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Good to hear. Thank you, Elysium.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: There's bad news too, though. If the enemy isn't in front, they're probably behind us.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Watch your six, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: The cannonfire is drawing closer...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The group can't move any faster.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Even worse, we have no idea where they are.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: We need more information, Amiya. At least, we need to know how they're moving.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You want to intercept military comms? Can you do that?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm familiar with Ursine military encryption methods, but it's been a while and it'll take time for me to identify the frequency that they're using.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Why are you looking at me like that?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Alright alright. Want me to leak even more classified information than I already have? Well, I can't guarantee it will help...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: But if we both live to stand before a military tribunal, I'll testify that all you did was purely in self-defense.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Your jokes could use some work, Sergeant.

spans.text: Your jokes could use some work,

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: I never said it was a joke. Please, consider lowering your expectations.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: They're low enough. Just tell me the frequency, then... 'keep quiet.'

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Uh, I'll write it down.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Found it. Thank you.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Tracing signal... switching to active... ship-mounted radio? Let me see...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: '...rebellious Infected miners at large in the Far North...'

a.text: 'The Infected have engaged in large-scale massacres, causing significant civilian casualties. A large number of armed Infected are now heading to Deity Grypherburg.'
'The Fourth Army hereby answers the call of duty to suppress the insurrection in order to protect Deity Grypherburg and the people.'
'The operation will be carried out swiftly. Citizens are advised to remain calm and cooperative.'

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: What? Their shamelessness leaves you at a loss for words?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: I'm unsurprised.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Sounds like they'll at least avoid the nomadic cities, but we should monitor civilian communications just in case... anyone have a map?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: Not on me. I'll get it—

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I have it here.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Can I, listen to, what you're listening to?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I want to know, about the other, mines...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Are we, the only ones, who left? Were there, others...?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: What they say on the radio isn't true, Vetochki.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I-I know!

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Just wanted to know, if they're safe. Can we?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: It's true that radio broadcasts from the mines could be a source of information. Thank you, Vetochki.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Lieutenant Gorchekova, please mark on the map any nomadic cities in the path of the Armies' heading.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Wait... the signal has been changed...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Military channel. That one just now was on civilian channels. Now they're sharing internal communications with other units.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: 'Purged?'

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: They're purging...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Don't listen, Vetochki!
Raidian tries to cover her ears, but the girl shakes her head.
The next message comes through after a brief silence.
Names of places mixed with static are sent back one after another from the terminal. Some are familiar, some are not. No one dares imagine what is happening on the other side.
A name. Just a name.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: That's enough. Turn it off.

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: We're not getting any more information... turn it off.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: No... no...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I want to know... I want, to know.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: They're... our friends.
The terminal's playback is like a bland, looping song.
The aurora sways in the night sky, a beautiful curtain that shuts out the screaming happening elsewhere on this tundra.
It is a long night.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: ...I understand, Your Imperial Majesty. I always have.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: I understand your kindness. But no one has ever been respected for kindness...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: What will happen to a nation, when it loses the energy that is its lifeblood?

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Either it becomes livestock whose survival depends on the whims of others, or it must plunder the others first.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: This is not the desire of the Armies... it is the desire of Ursus.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Ursus must not be weak. If she becomes weak, we must cut away what is weak, or the others will fall upon her in an instant.

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: All of this to say...

steps.name: Grand Duchess Elisabeth
steps.text: Silence can be such a difficult thing.
Grand Duchess Elisabeth tosses the letter with the State Council's seal into the fireplace.
The flames rise with a soft hiss, then all is quiet again.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Vetochki... calm down and listen to me.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Don't be afraid... don't give up. We can make it. We'll take everyone out of this place.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I want to leave...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: But, 'massacre'... killing people? They're trying to... shut everyone up?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: They used to do it, with butter, and coffee. Then, with whips, and death.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Papa and Mama, didn't keep quiet, so they're... dead.

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: Vetochki...

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: But what if, we're dead, even if, we keep quiet?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: The mining districts, what we heard... they're all dead? But we're, the only ones, who know.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Shouldn't more people know, before we're, silenced too?

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: They can't, kill everyone.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Can they?

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: You're right. But sending a message would reveal our position to the nearby Army...

steps.name: Eloysius
steps.text: We...
Eloysius swallows her words. She wanted to be the voice of cold reason, but she cannot say the words.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Vetochki is right.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: We can't let them bury everything that happened here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You've just been through a hard fight, Mantra.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: There's no need to worry. It's my duty.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I can't NOT worry...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You didn't want to come to the north, or reveal your Arts. There must be reasons for that, whether it's a past you didn't want to expose, or...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island won't place undue burdens on our operators. I don't know what you went through here, but I know it takes great courage to overcome it.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding, Amiya. But I no longer need to avoid it, for I've left it behind.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: We'll reveal the tragedy that happened here, and expose their plot to all.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: A-Alright!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: And we have a witness.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Let's begin.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Calibration complete... how are you feeling?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: We'll expand the area, then. Raidian?

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: One moment. Maybe I can make use of the magnetic storms. The electrical signals carried in the noise...

steps.name: Raidian
steps.text: How are you feeling now, Mantra?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I can hear more now.
'More' is a vague answer. She not only hears more, she hears further, hears more details—
She hears the battleship's tracks rumbling across the tundra, the screams that not even Originium engines and guns can drown.
She hears parents speaking southern Ursine dialects, kissing their children goodnight; couples whispering words of love on the balcony before going inside, the curtains left open.
She hears a radio program in the Northern Tundra, interrupted from time to time by the magnetic storms; an old man falling asleep stroking a cloudbeast in his arms in a nursing home...
She feels as though she can hear everything, and she knows she has to interrupt.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'Comrades—'
Mantra suddenly realizes that she should not be the one saying the words.
At least, not the only one.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Vetochki.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: Y-Yes?

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: These are your words.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Say them with me.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: But I, don't speak, clearly—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You can do it.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I, I—

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'Comrades in the mines and cities.'

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: 'C-Comrades, in the mines, and cities.'

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'We come from the Far North.'

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: 'We come from... the Far North.'

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: 'We are being slaughtered.'

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: 'We are b-being...'
Comrades, in the mines, and cities. We are hunted miners from the Far North.
We are still alive, but we are being slaughtered.
We did not betray Ursus.
Ursus abandoned us.

steps.name: Vetochki
steps.text: I-I did it!

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: You did it.

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: Now...

steps.name: Mantra
steps.text: I might need some help.
